task: ae.minilang: tiny integer language with parser, checker, tree interpreter, optimiser, bytecode compiler, verifier and VM, cross-checked by seeded differential tests
reasoning_summary: Specified semantics first (scoping, depth limit, error kinds, optimiser safety rules), wrote front-end, arithmetic, execution, verifier and optimiser tests before the matching code, then added a seeded generator of terminating programs that provokes overflow and division by zero. Two test-side defects (generator reused parameter scope, wrong optimiser expectation about block flattening) were fixed in attempt 2; all 64 tests then passed and 11 of 12 mutants were killed (the survivor is equivalent).
